description: This image helps the reader understand that a Fibonacci–Catalan polynomial is a list of coefficients that are never negative: C(q) for m = 4, n = 3, = [5]_q[8]_q/[2]_q has coefficients 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1, and the theorem says every such polynomial with gcd(m,n) ≤ 2 behaves the same way.
head: Fibonacci–Catalan polynomials: never negative
sub: The case m = 4, n = 3 has coefficients 1, 1, 2, 2, 3, 2, 3, 2, 2, 1, 1, built from the Fibonacci numbers 5, 8 and 2.
